_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION DATA. Fictional, procedurally generated for the BAYOU-NOVA proof of concept (2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge). Not real crew data. Not a medical record. Not for clinical use.
scenario_description: Stable profile. After launch, values settle at a steady level (resting HR a little above preflight, sleep shorter than preflight, blood pressure slightly lower) and show no consistent direction since. Whether each shift is expected adaptation is not established for an individual.

preflight_baseline.basis: Mean of 56 preflight daily readings (Mission Day -56 to -1), except VO2 max (single preflight lab test at Mission Day -30).

privacy_notice: Demo uses a fictional scenario. The platform cannot guarantee privacy without a formal impact assessment and makes no claim of anonymity. Crew-level information is framed environmentally.
